evidence.detail: Return object renamed from `{ occupied, available }` to `{ used: occupied, available }`. Only the property key changed; the value bound to `occupied` (i.e. `duration(minutes, reserve, resource)`) is identical.
Caller switched from `capacity.occupied / (capacity.available + 1)` to `const { used, available } = intervals.capacity(...); return used / (available + 1);`. Same arithmetic, new key name.

Four-state diagnostics: baseline and left-only both fail with `'used' does not exist on { occupied, available }`; right-only fails with `'occupied' does not exist on { used, available }`; merged state removes the property error, confirming the edits are mutually required and consistent.
Invariant coverage shows the single caller is `roomPressure` (line 42) and no tests or comments reference the old `occupied` key, so no downstream contract is silently broken.
